test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.

The actor said that what he did in films was something he had never attempted in real life.

options.text: The actor said, “What I do in films is something I have never attempted in real life.”
The actor said, “What he did in films was something he had never attempted in real life.”
The actor said, “What I am doing in films is something I have never attempted in real life.”
The actor said, “What he did in films is something he has never attempted in real life.”

solution:
The correct answer is **'The actor said, “What I do in films is something I have never attempted in real life.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• To change from *indirect to direct speech*, we use the following steps - 

 
 
• The **reporting verb said** remains unchanged.
 
• Put a comma (,) after 'The actor said...'
 
• Remove the **conjunction that**.
 
• Insert** inverted commas ("...") **to mark the statement part of the direct speech.
 
• Capitalize the first word of the statement. (**What**)
 
• Change **past tense forms (did, was) **of reporting verbs into **present tense forms (do, is).**
 
• Change **past perfect tense (had never attempted)** into **past tense (have never attempted)**.
 
 
 
• When we follow the above steps, we get the following sentence - The actor said, “What I do in films is something I have never attempted in real life."
 
• Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.
